sources.title: Using Marine Plans
sources.role: Statutory marine-plan guidance and decision-support context
sources.facts: Published 1 April 2026; marine plans guide English marine-area use and development.
sources.origin: Official UK government, regulator or national-statistics publication accessed 2026-07-30.
sources.guard: Marine plans, licensing collections, shoreline management plans and coastal-risk products are strategic, mapped or procedural evidence; they do not by themselves prove exact-site consent, licence status, defence funding, erosion outcome or deliverability.
